title: Water Pressure vs. Head
description: Pressure in pounds per square inch (psi) vs. head in feet of water (ft h2o). Convert between pressure and head measurements using standard conversion factors.

components.content:
## Water Pressure vs. Head Converter

Convert between pressure in pounds per square inch (psi) and head in feet of water (ft H₂O).

**Conversion Factors:**
- 1 ft H₂O = 0.4335 psi
- 1 psi = 2.307 ft H₂O

Select your conversion type below.

## Reference Information

**1 ft H₂O = 0.4335 psi = 62.43 lbs/ft²**

**1 psi (lb/in²) equivalent to:**
- 144 psf (lbf/ft²)
- 6894.8 Pa (N/m²)
- 2.307 ft H₂O
- 27.71 in H₂O at 61°F (16.7°C)
- 703.1 mm H₂O at 61°F (16.7°C)
- 0.06895 atm

**Example:** A head of 64 ft H₂O = 27.7 psi
